name: Global Polynomial Roots Obfuscation
description: I replaced the local matrix determinant constraint with a global sum of a degree-4 polynomial evaluated on the differences of assigned values. The polynomial evaluates to 4 if the values are equal and 0 if they are unequal. Because the terms are non-negative, the sum is 0 if and only if all adjacent pairs have different values. Models that pattern-match will fail to prune their search space and TLE, while models that genuinely analyze the polynomial's range will discover the local inequality constraint and succeed.
